High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[General Carlist Rieekan (V)]] (Virtual Set 8, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 8/Light/General Carlist Rieekan.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rf-aSrCZH3UoLxc3kruRxr90ApKChgU4/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>General Carlist Rieekan.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,148 bytes, SHA-256 <code>ce02e5aa663be11bce53321836158b8e88b79adb65f51b63a5404f82b02e3379</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V8-L-generalcarlistrieekan-2018-07-08.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee).
